descriptions.pages_detail: Read first-party public OMAKASE restaurant document metadata for a source restaurant id. Returns source page metadata; use restaurants show, courses, release or availability for normalized planning semantics. This tool cannot book or confirm seats.
descriptions.pages_list: Read first-party public OMAKASE catalogue restaurant links from the current source page. Returns bounded source links rather than course details or available seats. Use restaurants find for literal name filtering and structured pagination coverage.
